systems.name: Public Employees' Retirement System

statute.quote: A defined benefit retirement plan is created and established to become effective July 1, 1945.

body.name: Public employees' retirement board (Montana Public Employee Retirement Administration, MPERA)

source.quote: The board shall administer the provisions of the chapters enumerated in 19-2-302 .

website_source.quote: Retirement Systems Public Employees' Retirement System (PERS) Firefighters' Unified (FURS) Highway Patrol Officers' (HPORS) Game Wardens' and Peace Officers' (GWPORS) Judges' (JRS) Municipal Police Officers' (MPORS) Sheriffs' (SRS) Volunteer Firefighters Compensation Act (VFCA)

covers_local_source.quote: Any municipal corporation, county, or public agency in the state may become a contracting employer through a contract entered into between the board and the legislative body of the contracting employer.

systems.notes: The system consists of the defined benefit plan (Census unit) and a defined contribution plan (19-3-2102). School district classified staff are PERS members.
